about: I’m a dad and grandpa, usually working on a house or some other project. I help run a little bookstore in Lakewood and do renovation work too.
lead: Mostly, I just want to know the people around me better. If I can help, connect you with someone, or you just want to grab coffee, reach out.
reassure: Tell me who you are and I'll save your number too. I reply the same day.
